Dear [family member],

Thank you for your further email regarding your request, reference FOI2026/23886.

We have considered the additional information you have provided, including the alternative historical names and locality descriptions for Great House Farm / Tŷ Mawr. We note that you have confirmed that the scope and period of your original request remain unchanged.

The additional information does not change our response of 21 October 2026. Defra maintains its position that the information requested is not held by the Department.

As advised in our original response, the information may be held by the Welsh Government. You may therefore wish to contact the Welsh Government directly:

https://www.gov.wales/contact-welsh-government#52148

Yours sincerely
